basis: All secrets come from per-run secrets.token_hex(32), not user/production credentials or committed literal values
Inherited environment is allowlisted; all six PostgreSQL role credentials are newly generated and commands target the owned disposable loopback cluster
TemporaryDirectory uses unique atomic mkdir with 0700; path is beneath hardcoded /private/tmp, not caller TMPDIR
pwfile is inside that parent, chmod 0600 before initdb, normal unlink immediately after initdb and before PostgreSQL starts
Parent 0700 restricts other UID traversal during write_text-beforechmod window; no untrusted preexisting child/symlink under normal OS semantics
Generated password/full DSN are scrubbed from captured output; command reports contain file path, not password contents
Existing recorded cluster/temporary-file/PID cleanup is positive and narrower than erasure; original unsupported destruction claim remains uncredited
No references/imports/execution found in CI/frontend/tools build/test entrypoints; unittest discovery targets tools and backend-fork/scripts, not archived docs
Docker context explicitly excludes docs and runtime packager only includes allowlisted server/config/package/.next/public/dependencies; archived scripts are not shipped
adversarial_limits: write_text creates plaintext beforechmod and lacks O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW; mitigation relies on the fresh0700 parent and trusted same UID/root actors, not an intrinsically safe file API

Root/same UID actors can read/replace files, inspect process/environment memory or introduce symlinks; hostile ACL/capability/instrumentation/filesystem behavior is outside this bounded accepted host trust
The file is normally short-lived, but initdb exception skips immediate unlink until TemporaryDirectory cleanup; SIGKILL/host loss can leave pwfile/cluster alive
Cluster-start acknowledgment/drain handling is not a complete crash-recovery proof; do not claim all abnormal exits cleaned up
unlink/rmtree does not prove secure disk, swap, backup, memory or cryptographic erasure; leftover ephemeral credentials are not production credentials
Output redaction handles selected known values/patterns and normal complete lines, not malicious output transformations or a universal secret audit
Archive code remains manually executable by a trusted developer; accepting this snapshot does not endorse reusing it for live databases, untrusted hosts or unattended automation
